To release a stage, move what it holds into server.json in the main push of its day: its messages, posts and threads appended, its roles and onboarding replacing server.json's own, each edit applied to the message, post or tidy entry it names, and every file in needs already on main in an earlier push. node tools/discord-check.mjs plays these stages one after another against a fake Discord, so each one is proved to post within the brake (two new posts a run, one of them to @everyone). Source of the words: docs/SEASON0-THEME.md (sections 2b to 2f, 3) and docs/SEASON0-BRIEF.md section 6. English, no dashes, signed 師 Shibaki.

messages.title: 開山 Season 0 · The Founding begins Monday 26 October
body: **Everyone starts again. The first names are carved for ever.**

The closed test ends on **Monday 26 October at 00:00 UTC**. In the Americas that is Sunday 25 October: 21:00 in São Paulo, 20:00 in New York, 17:00 in Los Angeles. Season 0 begins in that same second.

**No progress carries over.** Every cultivator, on every device, starts again in the first realm. This is the one wipe we promised for the end of the closed test, and it is the last one. Your account and your name carry over.
fields: 同 驗 永 The season's law

同 The season opens for everyone at the same second, in the first realm.
驗 Every rank is checked from the first second.
永 Nothing is wiped again.
先行 Forerunner

Everyone who played the closed test and is in 榜 Ranks by the switch carries one mark: a small gold seal, 先行 Forerunner, beside your name on every board. It is the same for everyone, it is for good, and it changes no number. A mark, not a save.
▸ How to be a Forerunner

Join 榜 Ranks in the game once before **Monday 26 October, 00:00 UTC** (Sunday 25 October in the Americas). A guest only needs a name. If you are already on the boards, there is nothing to do. Until then the game also shows you the deadline in your own time.
題名崖 The Cliff of Names

Season 0's own monument: nine columns, one for each gate, from the Spirit Fox to the Dragon. The first 81 cultivators through each gate are carved on it, with the date the server saw them. A new column opens every few days for about five weeks. Only players in 榜 Ranks are carved, and every carving is checked.
▸ The trailer
[Watch the Season 0 trailer](https://hyoddougamer-dev.github.io/ninefold/discord/season0/founding-trailer.mp4). One minute; the voice is made with elevenlabs.io.
▸ What stays
Losing a fight costs nothing. Nothing is taken away for being away. Every system you know is still there, opening realm by realm as before.
▸ If the game is open at the switch
Take the update when it offers it. The first time you open Season 0, the game says goodbye to your closed-test cultivator in one line, and you begin again.

body: The Season 0 trailer is out, and today's update gets the game ready for the switch on Monday 26 October at 00:00 UTC. Until then you play the closed test exactly as before.
fields: ▸ The trailer

[Season 0 · The Founding 開山 · trailer](https://hyoddougamer-dev.github.io/ninefold/discord/season0/founding-trailer.mp4) (voice: elevenlabs.io). One minute: the seal falls once on the closed test, nine roads through the game, the Dragon, and the Cliff of Names, still empty.
終 The last week
The game shows one notice with the end of the closed test in your own time, and how to carry 先行 Forerunner: join 榜 Ranks once before the switch. A guest only needs a name.
先行 On the boards
Every account the ranked server has seen in the closed test wears a small gold 先行 seal beside its name, and so will every account that joins before the switch. Tap it to read what it means.
季 The season card

The first time you open the game after the switch, one card says goodbye to your closed-test cultivator in one line, shows the season's law and begins Season 0. No progress from the closed test is kept on the device.
轉世 Rebirth
What the rebirth polls asked for: a new life keeps all of its craft experience, a rebirth is confirmed by typing Reincarnate, and reborn lives climb their own 輪迴 Samsara board.

tidyEdits.title: Consider adding reincarnation option  after reaching Golden Immortal
final: rekaris, to answer you plainly. Live now: Rebirth (since 7 October), with an Echo of +5% to +12.5% a life that adds up to +25% across lives, then a slow tail to a roof of +35%. Since 19 October each craft keeps all of its experience (it was 25%), reborn lives climb a Samsara board of their own (hidden until your first rebirth, its record starts again at each rebirth, and once reborn you are listed there instead of on the Heaven List), and a rebirth is confirmed by typing Reincarnate. Not changing: the qi roof stays. Not built: a material or crafting speed bonus.

On 6 October we said there would be one wipe, at the end of the closed test. It comes on Monday 26 October at 00:00 UTC, when Season 0 begins, and it is the last one. No progress carries over. Your account, your name and the 先行 Forerunner mark do. Details in the announcements channel.

fields: ▸ The three boards

期榜 This Week: layers climbed since Monday. Everybody starts the week level, so a new player can top it in their first week. The rankings open here.
天榜 Heaven List: the furthest climb. Once you have reborn, you move to the 輪迴 Samsara board, ranked by the life you are living.
塔榜 The Tower: the highest floor.
▸ 位 Sect rank

Your sect rank comes from the realms you have opened and the thunder marks you carry: Inner Disciple 內門弟子 at Foundation, Core 核心弟子 at Nascent Soul, True 真傳弟子 at Void Refining, Guardian 護法 at Great Vehicle, Elder 長老 at your first mark, then Peak Lord 峰主, Supreme Elder 太上長老 and Ancestor 老祖 at 5, 10 and 20 marks. It never falls: not for being away, not for a rebirth, not when a season ends. Tap your rank at the head of 榜 Ranks to see the whole ladder.
▸ On the Android app
Sign in with your email like anywhere else, and type the 6-digit code from the email into the game. The app never needs to open the link.
▸ Without an account
≡ Menu → *Your save* → *Copy the save*, and on the other device *Restore from a copy*. The copy is sealed and restores exactly as it was.
▸ 盾 Fair play

Your save is sealed on your device: it reads as noise, and the game notices when one was changed by hand. That keeps the casual edit out. The real guard is the server: every climb on the boards is measured against how much real time has passed, so an edited save, a moved clock or a forged copy never reaches them. An edited save still plays on your device, because nothing is ever taken away. It is just never ranked.

body: **1 · Be kind.** This is a small community and everyone here is helping.
**2 · Share the game, not other servers.** Season 0 is open to anyone: send the game's link to whoever you like.
**3 · One bug, one post.** In {#bugs}, so nothing gets lost.
**4 · No spam, no ads,** nothing you would not show a stranger.
**5 · Members don't ping @everyone.** Some news and dev log posts ping everyone once, when they go up.
Invite links, scam links and mass mentions are held back automatically. The 守 Guardians see every one, and breaking the rules gets a warning, then a timeout.

posts.title: 題名崖 The Cliff of Names and 先行 Forerunner
body: **題名崖 The Cliff of Names** is Season 0's own monument, in 榜 Ranks. It has nine columns, one for each gate, each headed by its realm's painting: in ink until its first name is carved, then in colour.
Each column holds the **first 81 cultivators through that gate**, in order, with the date the server saw them. The Cliff is never wiped.
fields: ▸ The nine gates

妖狐 Spirit Fox: into realm 2
石猿 Stone Ape: into realm 3
仙鶴 Immortal Crane: into realm 4
雷虎 Thunder Tiger: into realm 5
玄武 Black Turtle: into realm 6
石傀 Stone Puppet: into realm 7
魔狼 Demon Wolf: into realm 8
蛟 Serpent Dragon: into realm 9
龍 Dragon: your first tribulation crossed
▸ When you are carved

When the server sees you in the next realm. From realm 5 to 8 a gate can stay sealed for up to two days after its warden falls, so you are carved once you are through it, not when the warden falls. If you climb offline, you are carved at your next sync, with that date.
▸ Who is carved

Only cultivators in 榜 Ranks: a player who has not joined is never carved. Every carving is checked like the boards. A save held for review drops off until it is cleared, then comes back at its first time.
▸ How fast the columns fill

From a fresh start, the first cultivators reach the Spirit Fox's gate within a day, the Thunder Tiger's in 5 to 16 days, and the Serpent Dragon's in 32 to 76, depending on how often they play. So a new column opens every few days for about five weeks. Your own place is lit on its column.
先行 Forerunner

A small gold seal with two characters, 先行, beside the name of every account the ranked server saw in the closed test: on every board, in 榜 Ranks, and at the foot of the Cliff under *Those who walked before*. It is the same for everyone and for good, and it changes no number. Tap it in the game to read what it means.
▸ Who wears it

Every account the ranked server saw before Monday 26 October, 00:00 UTC, apart from banned accounts and the developer's own. The list closed at the switch: nothing after it can add a name. A player who only played on a device, without joining Ranks, is not on it. On that device the game still remembers, for them alone, that they walked the closed test.
▸ Why two characters
先 alone before a name reads as *the late*, as in 先父, the late father. 先行 means *went first*, as in 先行者, a pioneer.
▸ Here in Discord
The 測 Tester role is now 先行 Forerunner. It is a courtesy for those who tested; the mark in the game is the record.
